mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.5% in the past month signals a tightening monetary policy, which increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate investments, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, or if the correlation between FEDFUNDS increases and negative returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate by more than 0.5% in the past two months signals a weakening labor market, which leads to reduced consumer spending and corporate earnings, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, or if the correlation between UNRATE increases and negative returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in housing starts by more than 5% over the past two months signals a weakening demand in the housing market, which is a leading indicator of broader economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, or if the correlation between HOUST declines and negative returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production by more than 2% over the past two months signals a strengthening supply side, which boosts corporate earnings and investor confidence, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, or if the correlation between INDPRO increases and positive returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained low inflation environment, indicated by CPIAUCSL below 2% for three consecutive months, signals a stable monetary policy, which reduces uncertainty and supports positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, or if the correlation between low CPIAUCSL and positive returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in nonfarm payrolls by more than 200,000 over the past month signals a strengthening labor market, which boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, or if the correlation between PAYEMS increases and positive returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) increase by more than 1% and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) decreases by more than 0.2% over the past two months, it signals a strengthening consumer demand and labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS increase > 1% and UNRATE decrease > 0.2% in 2 months
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, or if the joint effect of RSAFS and UNRATE changes on returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A combination of a low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 2%) and a positive GDP growth (GDPC1 increase > 0.5% over the past six months) signals an accommodative monetary policy with a growing economy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS < 2% and GDPC1 increase > 0.5% in 6 months
regime_hint: economic expansion with accommodative monetary policy
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, or if the joint effect of FEDFUNDS and GDPC1 on returns is not statistically significant (p > 0.05).
